integrity: Analytic Walsh and influence proof with finite exact exhaustive base-case checks; no extrapolation of numerical results to unproved regimes.
scientific_limitations: Exact labeled ground-state multiplicities are established only for the first two positive-coupling thresholds and the adjoining third open regime; later ratios for d>=6, external fields, and finite-temperature physics are not classified. Priority comparisons are bounded by accessible literature.
title: Two frustration thresholds and quartic coexistence degeneracy for hypercube Ising antiferromagnets
